name: OMSI 2: Project Numazu
summary:
OMSI 2: Project Numazu is a downloadable content expansion for the bus simulation game OMSI 2. Set in Numazu, a coastal city in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, the add-on recreates Japanese urban roads, residential neighborhoods, industrial areas, and landmarks surrounding Numazu Station and Numazu Port.

The expansion features four playable bus routes (N12, N13, N41, and N45), Japanese left-hand traffic, regional road signage, detailed bus interiors, interactive fare collection systems, and AI traffic.
